A second original-resolution pass on all nine panels with 1% autocontrast, 2x contrast, and a C/c/0-9 character whitelist also produced no 85 hit. This is a negative OCR result only: the installed engine has eng and osd, not Cyrillic, and dense faint labels remain outside reliable OCR. Visual source review or a clearer scan is still needed.

d42_d43_gap_candidate.candidate_basis: C85 is the sole member of the C82...C93 collective bypass range without a secure individual assembly position, but that uniqueness is circumstantial and does not identify this unlabeled outline.

decision: Keep C85 source-modeled with provisional collective +5 V/GND rails and PCB placement pending. The unlabeled D42/D43 assembly outline and matching owner bare-hole pair are a prioritized C85 candidate, not a proved refdes assignment. Do not place its footprint or mark DNP from this geometry. A factory refdes/BOM or continuity plus a unique assembly attribution is required.
next_inspection: With power off, probe the owner bare gap pair near (2055,2235)/(2055,2475) in 200452717.MP. First confirm each same-hole counterpart in solder 200534267 near (1688,2320) and the lower +5 V strip around (1684,2570); then meter separately to D42.7/D43.7/GND and D42.14/D43.14/+5 V, checking isolation. owner_d42_d43_gap_candidate.observation: Both independent July component views show two solder-filled round through-hole features at the midpoint of the D42/D43 inter-package gap. Their common centerline and approximately 240-pixel spacing match the two-lead assembly outline after orienting the factory panel to the owner package row. No capacitor body bridges them in either view. They are candidate original landing holes, not independently proved C85 holes or power-rail joins.
owner_d42_d43_gap_candidate.limit: The body outline is unlabeled, no per-hole two-face registration or continuity has been made, and solder crowns alone do not identify population history or the electrical rails.

solder_face_search.assessment: If both projected features are the two front bare holes, their opposite GND/+5 V bars fit a bypass capacitor. This strengthens the unlabeled outline as a C85 candidate but still does not prove its reference, pad polarity, population, or exact solder holes.
solder_face_search.overlap_coverage_limit: The D58-anchored 200530933.MP-to-200534267 translation documented in d42-d43-orientation-audit.json is approximately (-2664,+196) pixels. The candidate at x≈1684 in 200534267 would lie near x≈4348 in 200530933.MP, outside its 4080-pixel width. The rightward overlap 200537608 follows the same GND/+5 V strip system toward the power terminals but does not show the D42/D43 inter-package gap as a second independently registered feature field. Thus the available alternate solder views cannot disambiguate a lower drill beneath the broad +5 V strip; re-enlarging those tiles is not a substitute for continuity or a new oblique image.
